Course data dictionary

Source: R/data-course-data-dictionary.R
course_data_dictionary.Rd

Variable definitions for the mouse trial datasets included in the package.

Usage

course_data_dictionary

Format

A data frame with 28 rows and 7 variables:

dataset

Dataset name.

variable

Variable name.

type

Stored data type.

units

Measurement units, when applicable.

description

Short variable description.

allowed_values

Expected values or range, when applicable.

variant_notes

How the teaching variant differs from the core data.

Source

Generated from the package data definitions.

Examples

data(course_data_dictionary)
course_data_dictionary
